payload.reason: The evidence suggests that differences in cloudiness and precipitation between the Elwha and Quinault valleys influence solar radiation absorption and glacier dynamics, supporting the idea that the orientation of the grid affects glacier distribution.

claims.text: The Elwha valley is expected to receive more solar radiation due to being less cloudy than the Quinault valley, which can enhance glacier melt.
Differences in valley morphology and precipitation between the Elwha and Quinault valleys likely affect glacier dynamics and extent.
Spatially variable precipitation influences glacier extent, suggesting that the orientation of the grid may impact glacier distribution.
